Title: Azure Blockchain Workbench 1.7 integration with Azure Blockchain Service

Body.Content:
Azure Blockchain Workbench 1.7 is now available in preview. Along with our new Blockchain Service, this release can further enhance your blockchain development and projects. Deploy a new instance of Blockchain Workbench through the Azure portal or upgrade your existing deployments to 1.7. using our upgrade script. This update includes improvements to the integration with Blockchain Service and enhanced compatibility with Quorum.

Learn more about Azure Blockchain Service

Upgrade your existing deployments to 1.7. using our upgrade script

Visit Github to learn more about Blockchain Workbench 1.7 release notes
